logp.method_description: The log Po/w of the ruthenium complexes were followed shake flask method using the previously published procedure.9 A known amount of each complex (RuL1-RuL7) was suspended in water (presaturated with n-octanol) and shaken for 48 h on an orbital shaker. To allow the phase separation, the solution was centrifuged for 10 min at 3000 rpm. Then the amount of ruthenium present in saturated aqueous solution was measured by ICP-MS. To obtain the partition coefficient, different ratios (0.5:1, 1:1, and 2:1) of the saturated solutions were shaken with pre-saturated n-octanol for 20 min on an orbital shaker and followed the same procedure.
